data.title: Undermining scissors
data.summary: Scissors · Longer scissors with blunt, broad tips for undermining and blunt dissection with minimal trauma.
data.body:
![Undermining scissors](instruments/undermining-scissors.jpg)

_Also called: Metzenbaum scissors, Ragnell dissecting scissors_

Longer scissors with blunt, broad tips for undermining and blunt dissection with minimal trauma.

## Parts
- Two blades pivoting on a rivet/screw that acts as fulcrum; ring handles
- Long shanks relative to blades
- Blunt broad tips

## Types / variants
- Straight, curved or serrated
- Ragnell, Metzenbaum patterns

## Uses / indications
- Undermining wound edges before closure
- Soft tissue and blunt dissection

## How to hold
Tripod grip: thumb and ring finger in the rings (only up to the distal phalanx), index finger resting near the screw joint for stability.

## Sterilisation & care
Autoclave, hot air oven, 2% glutaraldehyde or boiling
